title: Create your first commit
goal: Create notes.txt containing the exact line 'learning Git', stage it, and commit it on main.
hint: Git adds only staged changes to the next commit.

title: Stage one path, keep another unstaged
goal: Stage the edited notes.txt but keep config.txt modified and unstaged.
hint: Inspect git diff and git diff --cached.

title: Create a topic branch
goal: Create branch feature/readme; add a '## Usage' heading to README.md and commit it. Keep main unchanged.
hint: git switch -c feature/readme

title: Push to a local bare remote
goal: Push local main to the preconfigured local origin so both branch tips match.
hint: git push -u origin main; no internet required.

title: Fast-forward a feature
goal: Integrate feature/checklist into main by fast-forward (no merge commit).
hint: git switch main; git merge --ff-only feature/checklist

title: Resolve an actual merge conflict
goal: On main, merge feature/red, resolve settings.txt to 'color=purple', and finish a two-parent merge commit.
hint: Inspect conflict markers, edit, git add, git commit.

title: Revert a shared mistake
goal: Revert the last commit so status.txt returns to 'healthy'; preserve the bad commit in ancestry.
hint: git revert --no-edit HEAD

title: Cherry-pick one fix
goal: On maintenance, cherry-pick the latest fix from main without moving main.
hint: git cherry-pick main

title: Recover a misplaced commit
goal: Use reflog to identify the commit removed by reset, then create branch recovered-work pointing to it.
hint: git reflog; git branch recovered-work <hash>

title: Locate a regression by bisect
goal: Find the first bad commit using git bisect; record its full 40/64-character Git hash in finding.txt. Reset bisect mode before grading.
hint: Known good: baseline commit; known bad: HEAD; test: python check.py

title: Use a linked worktree
goal: Create a worktree at the adjacent hotfix path on branch hotfix. Commit FIX.txt containing 'hotfix ready' in that worktree; main must remain untouched.
hint: git worktree add -b hotfix ../hotfix HEAD

title: Make an annotated release tag
goal: Create annotated v1.0.0 tag on main's current commit with a meaningful release message.
hint: git tag -a v1.0.0 -m 'Release 1.0.0'

title: Ignore generated files but keep an important log
goal: Commit .gitignore that ignores .env.local, build/ and *.log, except important.log. Commit important.log; leave generated files untracked and ignored.
hint: Use patterns .env.local, build/, *.log and !important.log; git add .gitignore important.log.

title: Stage only the first hunk
goal: In story.txt, stage only the line-03 change and keep the line-47 draft change unstaged.
hint: Try git add -p story.txt. Compare git diff --cached and git diff.

title: Restore a tracked file without losing notes
goal: Restore config.ini to its committed value while preserving untracked draft.txt and leaving commit history unchanged.
hint: Inspect status. git restore -- config.ini affects tracked worktree edits only.

title: Fetch a new remote commit without merging
goal: Fetch the newest main from the preconfigured LOCAL origin. Keep your own main branch on its original commit.
hint: Use git fetch origin; compare git rev-parse main and git rev-parse origin/main.

title: Rebase a feature onto updated main
goal: Rebase feature/reports onto the updated main, retaining one feature commit and the latest logging.conf.
hint: Already on feature/reports: git rebase main. Validate git log --graph.

title: Stash staged work and an untracked draft
goal: Stash staged README.md edits AND untracked draft.md so the working tree is clean, keeping the stash for later.
hint: Use git stash push -u -m 'WIP draft'; inspect git stash list and status.

title: Squash a feature into one mainline commit
goal: On main, combine the complete feature/promo changes into one new commit without adding a merge commit or rewriting feature/promo.
hint: git merge --squash feature/promo; git commit -m 'Add promotion'.

title: Revert a two-parent merge correctly
goal: Undo the latest merge on main, removing NOTICE.md but retaining ROADMAP.md and the original merge in history.
hint: Use git revert -m 1 --no-edit HEAD. Mainline parent 1 is main before the merge.

title: Attach review evidence with Git notes
goal: Attach a Git note containing 'Reviewed for release: checks passed' to HEAD without amending the code or commit.
hint: git notes add -m 'Reviewed for release: checks passed' HEAD.

title: Squash local feature history safely
goal: Combine the two feature/search commits into one new commit, preserving all content while keeping main unchanged.
hint: On feature/search, git reset --soft main then git commit. Only rewrite a private feature branch.

title: Use a focused sparse checkout
goal: Use cone-mode sparse checkout to populate docs and apps/api but not assets or data; do not alter Git history.
hint: git sparse-checkout init --cone; git sparse-checkout set docs apps/api.

title: Pin a local library as a submodule
goal: Add the sibling local library repo at vendor/library, commit its gitlink and .gitmodules on main, and keep the pointer to the library's current commit.
hint: git -c protocol.file.allow=always submodule add ../library vendor/library; git add .gitmodules vendor/library; git commit -m 'Pin local library'. No remote network.
